ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: A verdict of belatedness: the effective action or occasion has already passed while someone still tries to grasp or explain it. Several records join it to marking the boat only after the sword is gone.
EvidenceBody: Dongshan Jue asks whether the assembly knows that the sword has long since gone before striking the seat and descending.
Xiatang Huiyuan follows a Yunmen quotation with the verdict and the boat-marking image.
Baichi Xingyuan, Yunwai Xingze, Xutang Zhiyu, and Dongsi Ruhui use the same formula in their own addresses or appraisals.
